causes.mechanism: The naming stage drops a source-stated component, geometric reference or physical locus.
Producer bindings pool quantities whose loci, operations or physical meanings cannot share the stored definition.
Definition templates replace the source's selectable boundary with the last closed flux surface.
Naming or definition construction drops or substitutes the source's coordinate convention or reference axis.
Naming drops an explicit normalization or weighting that distinguishes the source quantity.
Naming drops a vacuum-field contribution restriction and can admit plasma-response or total-field interpretations.
The pressure-pedestal locus collapses to an unspecified pedestal in the name.
A signed safety-factor minimum is replaced with the minimum of its absolute value.
A source's average or aggregation disappears from the name or is explicitly excluded by a pointwise definition.
Definition construction substitutes a base quantity or an inconsistent equation for the named transform or derivative.
Domain assignment follows an equilibrium consumer instead of the iron-core or structural quantity itself.
A generic geometric template overrides the source's stated branch or point-selection rule.
Definition construction substitutes a different geometric or coordinate scope for the source's scope.
The source's thermal or total population basis disappears from the name or is mixed across bindings.

class_list: The name states a quantity, locus, component or relation that the Data Dictionary source text contradicts.

The source text states a qualifier of the quantity — a counting basis, a species basis, a weighting or average, a normalisation, a coordinate convention, a component or a locus — and the name leaves it out.
The stored definition (description or documentation) contradicts the Data Dictionary source text.
The stored name and the stored definition describe different quantities or different scopes, even if each is internally consistent.
The stored unit does not fit the quantity the name states: it is dimensionally wrong for that kind of quantity, or it is the wrong unit for the stated kind of quantity.
The assigned physics domain is not the domain of the quantity the source describes.
The name denotes the same quantity as another live standard name listed for it, so the catalog carries one quantity twice.

pilot.result: Resumed pilot will draw six members from scope-qualifier and shared-definition causes; boundary cases are excluded under coordinator ruling.

checkpoint: Coordinator authorized non-boundary continuation; registry and protected-spelling cases are parked for a separate ruling.

resumed_ruling.completion: Each member repaired and accepted or explicitly listed with its reason; registry-parked count retained.
